column1: # ESP-IDF — 16 MB flash (CoreS3). Classic xiaozhi-style SPIFFS assets @ 0xD00000 (label: assets).
# Dual OTA: two slots fill 0x20000 .. 0xCC0000; remainder 256 KiB = optional LittleFS "userdata".
# Sizes: ~6.62 MiB per OTA slot (fits current app); userdata is small — use SD/embedded for large UI caches.
